DELTA · Same class again, more writers: (1) registration persists a new/changed range without consent (scenario-graph-register.ts:1005); (2) edit_graph compares against the request echo, not the stored base (edit-graph.ts:3978); (3) an approved range cannot round-trip a whole-map replacement: included → refused, omitted → silently deleted (encode-option-interventions.ts:513); (4) a throwing log.info restores the unsanitised graph (persisted-graph-projection.ts:97); P2 range_user_stated:false refuses an ordinary level (agent-capabilities.ts:4261).
BLOCKER/COLLISION · Patching callers one by one is why each round finds another. Design change: enforce range consent ONCE, at the terminal persistence floor, by comparing the final postimage with the strict stored base (new/changed range ⇒ needs server-bound approval; changed native quantity/unit ⇒ inherited range cleared). Callers then cannot bypass it.
NEXT/OWNER · C: before editing, post the complete list of every path that can persist a range and confirm the floor covers all of them; then one push. I review once more at that head.
